items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: I was into Miles and Clifford Brown... So I always was attracted to it from the trumpet records I had.

ctx.x: And didn’t he have Inner City Records?

He had five record labels. Inner City, Classic Jazz, yeah. So I was kind of his — I did fifteen albums for him and I fought him all the way. Because I said, Irv — I must have quit a hundred times. “Irv, I’m not a Music Minus One guy. I want to do this for my legacy, these tributes to the legends: Charlie Parker, Clifford Brown, Ben Webster.” And he was in a different head but he loved the music so he let me do it. He invested about 70 grand in me. Because all those albums came out as jazz albums and they all came…
